about.title: About Sunbeam Solar
about.subtitle: Our mission is to make solar energy accessible to everyone.
about.paragraph1: We believe that clean, renewable energy should be simple and affordable. That's why we created Sunbeam Solar, to provide easy-to-install solar kits that anyone can set up in minutes.
about.paragraph2: Our team is made up of passionate engineers, designers, and solar enthusiasts who are dedicated to creating high-quality products that make a real difference in the world.
about.paragraph3: Join us on our journey to a brighter, cleaner future. With Sunbeam Solar, you're not just saving money on your electricity bills, you're investing in a sustainable planet for generations to come.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? We have answers. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact us.

questions.question: Do I need an electrician to install the kit?
questions.answer: Absolutely not! Our kits are designed for easy, DIY installation. You just plug it into a standard wall outlet. No tools, no electricians, no hassle.

questions.question: Is it compatible with my apartment?
questions.answer: Yes, our kits are perfect for apartments, condos, and rental properties. Since there are no permanent modifications to the building, you can take it with you when you move.

questions.question: How much can I actually save?
questions.answer: Savings vary depending on your location and electricity usage, but our customers typically see a 40-60% reduction in their monthly electricity bills. The kit often pays for itself in under a year.

questions.question: What happens during a power outage?
questions.answer: For safety reasons, our grid-tied inverters will automatically shut down during a power outage to prevent sending electricity back to the grid, which could endanger utility workers. It will automatically restart when power is restored.

press.title: They're talking about us
press.subtitle: Go solar with ease with Plug & Play photovoltaic kits!
press.p1: Plug & Play photovoltaic kits offer an accessible solution to produce your own electricity. Easy to install, they simply plug into a standard electrical outlet, without complex work.
press.p2: Each kit, carefully composed by professionals in the sector, includes one or two solar panels as well as a high-performance micro-inverter (up to 800W, Synergrid approved). This solution is ideal for DIYers wishing to reduce their energy bill with a more affordable initial investment.
press.p3: Before installation, a few checks are essential: electrical compatibility of your installation, compliance with town planning rules (especially if the kit is visible from the street), secure fixing and declaration to the network operator. Please note: regulations may vary by region.
press.p4: Our team is at your disposal to support you: find us in store at Solarstock, or contact us by phone at 02/241.08.00. We will be happy to answer your questions and guide you in your solar project.
